GM CT

Back in Manila!
I actually missed the traffic.

The horns, the chaos, the long rides that give you time to think, plan, and grind again. There’s just something about Manila mornings that hits different. busy streets, coffee in hand, and everyone chasing their goals.

While stuck in traffic, still locked in on @integra_layer.
Building through the noise, steady progress behind the scenes. These are the kind of moments that remind me why consistency matters. whether on the road or in Web3. Layer by layer, block by block, we keep moving forward.
New day. New energy. Let’s build. 

gintegra!
